payload.name: Preserve All Enumerated Categories in Extraction
payload.description: When a message confirms a question and adds multiple distinct people, groups, or items, during extraction preserve each explicitly named category.
content: During extraction, when a speaker enumerates two or more distinct people, groups, items, or attributes in a single message (including affirmations like 'Definitely!' followed by 'and...'), preserve each distinct category explicitly in the candidate content.

Do not merge or paraphrase the enumeration into a subset or shift modifiers between nouns; e.g., 'old friends and teammates from other tournaments' must yield both 'old friends' and 'teammates from other tournaments', not 'old teammates'.
Stop once every explicitly stated category is captured; do not infer unmentioned categories or expand the list.

solves: Extraction candidates sometimes paraphrase enumerated groups and drop an explicitly stated category, so future questions miss a fact. This skill keeps every distinct category named in an enumeration in the memory candidate.
